messages:
Maria (product): folks, we need a quick sync — PM asks for a lightweight metric surface for the microcost dashboard. main asks: cost_per_1k_tokens, cache_savings_pct, batch_savings_usd. can we map runtime inputs today?
Anil (eng-platform): quick yes, we have token_count, served_model, kv_cache_hit, batch_size in runtime event. gap is an aggregated cost signal per request.
Sasha (eng-runtime): correct — runtime emits `runtime.request` with tokens_in/tokens_out and `kv_cache` boolean. cost needs combining with pricing table (gpu_unit_cost / token).
Lia (analytics): do we want per-route breakdown or model-level only? downstream dashboards prefer both but start with model-level + top routes.
Maria (product): start model-level + a small top-10 routes heatmap. can we approximate cost_per_1k with a derived metric?
Anil (eng-platform): propose: cost_per_1k = (sum(token_compute_cost) / sum(tokens)) * 1000. tokens from runtime; token_compute_cost = tokens * model_unit_price. we store model_unit_price in pricing service keyed by model_id.
Sasha (eng-runtime): sending sample mapping for telemetry agent: ```json
{
  "event": "runtime.request",
  "fields": ["request_id","model_id","tokens_in","tokens_out","kv_cache_hit","batch_size","route_id"]
}
```
Anil (eng-platform): thanks — analytics needs semantic names and types. Lia, can you accept these field names? any transformations you want at ingest?
Lia (analytics): sounds good. prefer we precompute tokens_total = tokens_in + tokens_out and cache_hit_flag = kv_cache_hit ? 1 : 0. also attach timestamp_bucket for 1m rollups.
Omar (eng-sre): tagging for quota routing: when batch_savings_usd becomes material we may need to route to dedicated pools. is there a threshold we want surfaced in the console?
Maria (product): yes — show "estimated_batch_savings" and an action link: "promote to reserved" when savings > $0.50 per 1k on average for 24h. can that be signaled?
Anil (eng-platform): we can add a derived signal `avg_batch_savings_per_1k_24h` computed in metrics pipeline. trigger hook in console if > 0.5. will need an alert flag in telemetry.
Sasha (eng-runtime): runtime can emit `batch_effective_savings` per request if we know fallback price vs served price. but that's extra CPU. cheaper to compute in pipeline.
Lia (analytics): pipeline plan: ingest runtime.request, join pricing table snapshot (hourly), compute metrics: cost_per_1k, cache_savings_pct, batch_savings_usd; store into metrics.timeseries with tags: model_id, route_id, region, pool_type.
DevEx-bot: deploy check: metric schema change requires feature-flagged rollout. opening RFC-2445 and a small migration job to backfill last 30d.
Maria (product): timeline? PM wants preliminary dashboard mock by Tuesday.
Anil (eng-platform): I'll own the telemetry contract + pipeline handoff. Sasha can you add the `route_id` to runtime.events for next deploy?
Sasha (eng-runtime): will add route_id and tokens_total in the next minor release (ETA 48h).
Lia (analytics): I'll draft the pipeline SQL and share a saved query. need pricing snapshot format: {model_id, price_per_1k_tokens_usd}.
Omar (eng-sre): one more: add a boolean `is_dedicated_pool` tag from routing so dashboard can filter on dedicated vs hosted.
Anil (eng-platform): good call. we'll expose `pool_type` enum (hosted|dedicated|private).
Maria (product): awesome. thanks all — can everyone drop a quick thumbs when they have the PR opened? will collate for PM update. :thumbsup:
Anil (eng-platform): PR opened for telemetry contract: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/812
Sasha (eng-runtime): runtime PR for fields: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2194 (route_id + tokens_total)
Lia (analytics): pipeline draft: https://internal.redwood/saved/metrics/1k_cost_pipeline_draft
DevEx-bot: reminder: run `./tools/telemetry/validate_schema --schema telemetry_v3` before merging.
Maria (product): perfect — I'll queue the mock dashboard with these fields and loop back after you all have merged.
